entries.en:
Ardashir is determined to supplement the anima's aetheric energies so that it might relay its thoughts clearly and concisely. To that end, he proposes improving the aetherial conductivity of the weapon not only to give the anima the strength to converse, but to allow those without the Echo to comprehend that which is communicated. Gerolt begrudgingly agrees to assist. To work on the anima weapon, however, he must first insulate his tools with a soulglaze, and for that he requires five pots of aether oil. He bids you seek out Eorzea's traders of ancient antiquities to procure what he requires.

※You may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: You return with pots of aether oil in hand to find Gerolt in unusually high spirits. He soon reveals the reason for his good mood, namely that he has, in fact, consumed a large volume of spirits. Deaf to Ardashir's plea to lower his hammer, Gerolt begins pounding away with surprising speed and precision. It is not long before his work is complete and you take up a weapon seemingly alive with aether. As you raise it high to bask in its warm glow, the anima suddenly manifests itself to you. It is thankful for its newfound strength, and vows to do what it can to aid you in your coming adventures. Though he cannot yet perceive the anima, Ardashir is glad to see you sharing such a lengthy exchange, and looks forward to seeing how the anima will take shape under your guidance.
entries.fr: Vous avez remis <frnoun(Item,2,14899,2,1)> à Ardashir, qui s'est empressé d'en enduire les outils de Gerolt. Une fois son travail terminé, le forgeron vous a remis votre arme anima, qui brillait d'une lueur plus majestueuse que jamais. L'esprit synthétique qui l'habite s'est alors montré, et vous avez cette fois-ci réussi à communiquer avec lui<nbsp>! Il vous a reconnu<if(gnum4,e,)> comme son maître et a insisté pour vous accompagner lors de vos futurs voyages. Vos deux collaborateurs n'ont cependant toujours pas réussi à le voir... Désormais en possession d'une arme anima hyperconductrice, continuez à parcourir le monde et à combattre pour renforcer votre complicité avec l'esprit et peut-être bientôt communiquer de nouveau avec lui<nbsp>!

Which is why I took the liberty of investigating you and your dealings in Eorzea.

entries.en: Unlike the quasi-souls of golems and other constructs, the anima is unique in that it was created using the pure aetherial energies of astral and umbral nodules. As such, it bears no residual imprint of another psyche, and therefore possesses the potential for cognizance and growth.

entries.fr: Il ne fait aucun doute qu'en absorbant davantage de cette énergie, il pourra poursuivre son développement. Et j'ai bon espoir qu'au cours du processus, il acquière la faculté de communiquer avec son maître et de le comprendre.

entries.en: Have you no decency!? We did not come here to fashion trinkets. We came here to imbue weapons with life! Life that should be respected!
entries.fr: Vous n'avez pas honte<nbsp>!!!? Avec tous les efforts que nous y avons consacrés, j'espérais que vous traiteriez les armes anima avec un peu plus de respect<nbsp>! En tout cas, hors de question que je sois mêlé à vos activités frauduleuses<nbsp>!

entries.en: Respectin' life don't come into it. I came here to pay off me debts, remember. An' if that means makin' a few trinkets, I'll bloody well make 'em. Like it or not, where there's muck, there's money, an' I mean to─hic!─take it.
entries.fr: J'ai jamais vu un rabat-joie comme toi, gamin. Où est le mal à se remplir les poches au passage<nbsp>? C'est l'argent qui fait tourner le monde, mais t'es encore trop naïf pour t'en rendre compte<nbsp>!
